title: State-Space (with initial outputs)
text: 指定初始输出。使用优化例程尝试找到满足该初始输出的稳态 x 值；按 {Initial conditions} 指定Initial state vector；{A}、{B}、{C}、{D}、{Parameter tunability} 指定 tunable representation of block parameters、{Allow non-zero values for D matrix initially specified as zero} 指定 Allow tunability of D matrix when D =、{Absolute tolerance}、{State Name (e.g., ''''position'''')} 指定 Option to assign unique names to states，按实例取值。
